QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_18

question.text: Using the same fund (Rs. 50 crore cap, 10% hurdle, 15% incentive), what is Year 1 incentive fees if NAV Pre-incentives is Rs. 56.42 crore?

explanation.text: The Logic: Example 2 of the workbook computes eligible incentive fees as 15% of the excess over the reference hurdle. The excess is Rs. 1,42,34,000, and 15% of that is Rs. 21,35,100 — approximately Rs. 21.35 lakh. The Trap: Rs. 8.47 lakh and Rs. 42 lakh do not match the workbook's arithmetic. Rs. 1.42 crore is the excess over the hurdle itself, not the 15% incentive computed on that excess. Note: The Rs. 1,42,34,000 excess and Rs. 21,35,100 incentive figures are taken directly from Example 2 of the AIF (Category III) Distributors workbook (Series XIX-B).
